description: Gate a model call BEFORE it runs. Pass metadata only (model, token counts, endpoint URL), never prompt content. Returns allow/block plus an Ed25519-signed, content-free receipt with model and hosting provenance (weights origin, jurisdiction, retention). Unknown self-hosted models need set_model_cost first (fail-closed). Optional agent_id, task_id and workflow_id accept identifiers only; spend_decide binds them into the signed actor. Read-only and cost-configuration tools accept these fields without recording a spend decision.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier; signed as actor.agentId on spend_decide

endpoint_url.description: Endpoint URL. Unrecognized endpoints route as self-hosted (zero retention, your jurisdiction).

model.description: Model name, e.g. llama-3.1-8b-instruct or gpt-5-mini

task_id.description: Optional task identifier; signed as actor.taskId on spend_decide

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow identifier; signed as actor.workflowId on spend_decide

name: spend_decide
